# IFC test fixtures — sources and licenses

Every `.ifc` file in this directory is third-party content. Sources and
licenses are tracked below so we can comply with the originating licenses
when redistributing the OpenProject codebase.

## buildingSMART Certification-datasets

The 35 files below are all IFC datasets of the official buildingSMART
[`Certification-datasets`](https://github.com/buildingSMART/Certification-datasets)
repository (formerly `Sample-Test-Files`) at commit
[`80d976a`](https://github.com/buildingSMART/Certification-datasets/tree/80d976a).

The files were not modified beyond renaming: the schema is appended to each
file name so that the same scene in different schemas can coexist.

## OpenProject `modules/bim/spec/fixtures/files/minimal.ifc`

`minimal-IFC2X3.ifc` is a copy of `modules/bim/spec/fixtures/files/minimal.ifc`,
already shipped in this repository as a BIM-module test fixture. It is a
Revit-exported IFC2X3 file. Its original provenance and license predate this
extension; see the BIM module's history for context.

## OpenProject `extensions/web-ifc-xeokit-metadata/test/fixtures/minimal-alignment-IFC4X3.ifc`

`minimal-alignment-IFC4X3.ifc` is an artificial test case for IFC4X3 alignment (train tracks on bridges, etc.). This
feature has no upstream test file with a compatible license yet.
